key_concepts: Reproduction produces offspring similar to parents and ensures species continuity
Sexual reproduction requires sex cells from two parents
Fertilization is the union of sperm and egg cells
A fertilized egg is called a zygote
Butterflies reproduce sexually and lay eggs that hatch into larvae
Frogs reproduce sexually with external fertilization in water
Mosquitoes reproduce sexually and lay eggs in water or moist places
Dogs have a heat cycle and give birth after about 63 days of pregnancy
Cats ovulate only after contact with a male cat
Different animals have different modes of sexual reproduction
